description_en: Query the SDG mount status under a specific AIC instance
description_zh: 查询某个AIC实例下的SDG挂载情况
kebab_example: aliyun ens describe-instance-sdg-status --instance-id aic-xxxxx --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --status success --sdg-ids sdg-1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeInstanceSDGStatus

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AIC instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries returned on each page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The deployment status of the SDG
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The IDs of SDGs that you want to query. By default, all SDGs are queried
parameters.help_zh: 指定查询若干SDG，默认查询全部
parameters.name: sdg_ids
